map.Birmingham Vasculitis Activity Score v3，: Birmingham Vasculitis Activity Score v3, assesses systemic vasculitis (ANCA-associated etc.) disease activity over the past 4 weeks
map.提示：BVAS v3用于系统性血管炎(ANCA相关血管炎GPA/MPA/EGPA: Note: BVAS v3 assesses activity of systemic vasculitis (ANCA-associated GPA/MPA/EGPA, large-vessel arteritis etc.) based on new or worsening manifestations within the past 4 weeks. BVAS>15 suggests high activity, needs active induction therapy. VPAL (Vasculitis Damage Index) assesses irreversible organ damage, complementary to BVAS. ANCA titer change does not fully parallel BVAS change; do not adjust therapy by ANCA alone. For clinical reference only.
map.分组计分：全身发热3+皮肤紫癜3+肾血尿/蛋白尿6+肺出血/浸润4+神经2 =: Grouped scoring: general fever 3 + skin purpura 3 + renal hematuria/proteinuria 6 + pulmonary hemorrhage/infiltrate 4 + neuro 2 = 18, moderate-severe activity, induction needs high-dose steroid + cyclophosphamide/rituximab.
map.近 4 周无活动项 → 0，缓解期维持，监测 ANCA 滴度。: No active items in past 4 weeks -> 0, maintain remission, monitor ANCA titer.
map.BVAS v3 覆盖 9 系统并按严重度封顶；总分 0 无活动、1–14 轻中、: BVAS v3 covers 9 systems with severity caps; total 0 no activity, 1-14 mild-moderate, >=15 severe (incl. induction).
map.BVAS 降 50% 且达 0 常作缓解定义之一，用于临床试验终点。: BVAS drop 50% and reaching 0 is often one definition of remission, used as a trial endpoint.
map.血管炎BVAS评分器，Birmingham Vasculitis Activit: Vasculitis BVAS assessor, Birmingham Vasculitis Activity Score, assesses ANCA-associated vasculitis activity via 9 systems (general/skin/mucosa/ENT/pulmonary/cardiovascular/abdominal/renal/neuro). A medical professional tool based on authoritative medical standards, for reference only.
